summary: Full backend+frontend regression for MikiLab Pro Sala Sitor refactor (iter 225). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (gate 198505, admin login, deus bond/ask/capture/queue/clear, recipes list, deck status). Frontend E2E on preview URL: login flow OK, master-console visible, 5 capo groups exactly (piano/ordini/squadra/strumenti/sitor). Sala Sitor: all 14 required parts present (sala-sitor, sitor-input, sitor-send, sitor-intent-ordine/domanda, 4 sitor-mode-*, sitor-report-btn, sitor-queue, mike-suggestions, mike-alerts, nexus-console). Sitor AI reply received in ~2s. Ordine intent flow OK. Forbidden legacy testids ALL absent: ambient-mike-orb, talk-miki-launcher, hero-sitor, capo-deck, oven-brain. No data-zone='mikemix' section. WeeklyPlan/PianoAI: no weekly-shopping-shop-btn, 0 occurrences of 'Lista Spesa'/'Shelf-Life' in body. Recipe dialog opens; recipe-label-section absent, base fields (name, category, department, dough type, hydration) visible. Strumenti group contains panel-advanced-lab, panel-training, panel-mohamed-inbox, panel-living-recipe. Squadra: operators-roster + floor-lock present. Header activity-selector functional. No horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 or 390x844. 0 pageerrors. 1 minor React hydration warning (<span> as child of <option>).

issues: React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Not blocking but should be cleaned up.
